description: A simple escrow contract for secure transactions.
author: Nistha

functions.name: createEscrow
functions.description: Creates a new escrow agreement between a buyer and a seller.

inputs.name: amount
inputs.description: The amount to be held in escrow.

outputs.name: escrowId
outputs.description: The unique identifier for the created escrow.

functions.name: releaseFunds
functions.description: Releases the funds from escrow to the seller.

inputs.name: escrowId
inputs.description: The unique identifier of the escrow to release funds from.

functions.name: refundFunds
functions.description: Refunds the funds from escrow back to the buyer.

inputs.name: escrowId
inputs.description: The unique identifier of the escrow to refund funds from.
